Cibo Vita

Designing a cleaning cart, testing custom holders, and improving a cutter scraper.

Manufacturing Engineering / Operations Intern · Summer 2026

What I worked on

I designed the cart layout and CAD, developed the part holders, and tested 3D-printed prototypes with the actual components. I also worked on production-equipment improvements, including a cutter-scraper extension.

My internship involved observing production equipment, identifying recurring problems, developing possible fixes, and bringing designs forward for review and testing.

Cleaning-cart design

The cart was designed for disassembled MULTIPOND components. The parts had different shapes, so each needed an appropriate support and enough space for loading, rinsing, and drainage.

I arranged repeated component positions across the upper racks and left room for larger profiles below. The open frame provided access to the parts, while the casters allowed the cart to be moved.

Fit was only one consideration. The holders needed to support the parts without making loading and removal awkward. Their orientation needed to keep openings accessible and let water drain. I also considered durability under repeated handling and the cart’s overall weight.

Testing the holders

I used 3D-printed holders to check the interfaces with the actual parts. The main questions were whether the part fit, whether it stayed in place, and whether it was easy to load and remove.

I revised the holder geometry based on those checks and incorporated the changes into the cart design. This let me evaluate the part interfaces before manufacturing the complete cart.

The cart CAD and holder prototyping were completed, and the design was handed off for manufacture after my internship.

Cutter-scraper improvement

Product accumulated around a cutter scraper, requiring a cleaning stop roughly once an hour for about two minutes. I designed an extension/catcher below the blade path, selected a material and mounting approach, and supported installation and testing.

The installed change eliminated those recurring cleaning stops during testing. It was a small mechanical change with a clear result on the production equipment.
